JABVOX_ADVANCED_AUTOMATIONS.TITLE: Advanced Automations
JABVOX_ADVANCED_AUTOMATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Build advanced automation flows: triggers, conditions, loops and integrations.

ERRORS.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this module. You must be an administrator and have the module enabled for this account.
ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Advanced Automations module is not configured yet. Please contact the platform administrator.
ERRORS.GENERIC: Advanced Automations could not be loaded. Please try again later.
ERRORS.LOAD: The information could not be loaded.

CARD.TITLE: Automations Platform
CARD.BODY: Create and manage your advanced flows (integrations, triggers and chained actions) in the Automations app.

LIST.TITLE: Flows
LIST.EMPTY: No flows yet. Create the first one to start automating.
LIST.NAME: Name
LIST.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this flow? This cannot be undone.
LIST.DELETE_ACTIVE: Deactivate the flow before deleting it.

FORM.NAME: Flow name
FORM.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Notify the agent on a new lead

EDITOR.ADD_HINT: Drag a step onto the canvas or click to add it.
EDITOR.EMPTY_CANVAS: The canvas is empty. Add a trigger to begin.
EDITOR.NO_SELECTION: Select a step on the canvas to configure it.
EDITOR.NO_OUTPUT: Test the step to see its output.
EDITOR.DRAG_HINT: Drag a field onto a box to insert its reference.
EDITOR.NO_ISSUES: The flow has no problems: it can be activated.
EDITOR.ACTIVATE_BLOCKED: Fix the problems before activating the flow.
EDITOR.DOUBLE_CLICK_HINT: Double-click a step to open its detail view with input, configuration and output.
EDITOR.PENDING_READY: ready: click "Insert here" on the field you want.

RUNS.TITLE: Runs
RUNS.EMPTY: This flow has not run yet.

DATA.NO_FIELDS: This step exposes no fields: check the JSON view.

INPUT.SOURCE_SAMPLE: SAMPLE DATA: not data from your account
INPUT.SOURCE_LOOP_ITEM: First item of the loop's collection
INPUT.EMPTY_WITH_PREVIOUS: This step has no input data yet. Test the previous step to see it here.
INPUT.EMPTY_NO_PREVIOUS: This step has no previous step connected.

OUTPUT.SOURCE_SAMPLE: SAMPLE DATA: test the step to see the real output

PARAM.PATH_HINT: This field expects a field name, not an expression
PARAM.INVALID_JSON: The content is not valid JSON: changes will not be saved until it is fixed.
PARAM.BLOCKED_BY_DEPENDENCY: Choose "{field}" first to see the options.

NOTES.ADD_HINT: Add a note to the canvas (text only, never executed)

CLIPBOARD.LOCAL_ONLY: The browser blocked the system clipboard: you can only paste in this tab.
CLIPBOARD.READ_DENIED: The browser will not let us read the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V with the canvas focused.
CLIPBOARD.DROPPED_EDGES: {count} connection(s) were dropped because an endpoint was missing: {detail}.
CLIPBOARD.BROKEN_REFS: {count} reference(s) still point at steps that were not copied ({detail}): review them.
CLIPBOARD.SKIPPED_UNKNOWN: Steps of unknown type were skipped: {types}.
CLIPBOARD.ALL_UNKNOWN: No step could be pasted: this catalog does not know {types}.
CLIPBOARD.PARSE_MALFORMED_JSON: What you pasted is not a valid flow: the JSON is malformed.
CLIPBOARD.PARSE_NOT_AN_OBJECT: What you pasted is valid JSON but not a flow.
CLIPBOARD.PARSE_MISSING_FIELDS: The pasted flow is missing required fields or they have the wrong type.
CLIPBOARD.PARSE_NO_NODES: What you pasted contains no steps.
CLIPBOARD.PARSE_N8N_FORMAT: This is an n8n flow and its format is not compatible: step types and expression syntax differ. You will need to rebuild it with this catalog.

AUTOSAVE.CONFLICT_HELP: Another tab or user saved a newer version. Autosave stopped so it would not overwrite it.

VERSIONS.TITLE: Version history
VERSIONS.EMPTY: This flow has no saved versions yet.
VERSIONS.RESTORE_CONFIRM: You are about to restore version {version}. The canvas will show its contents instead of version {current}.
VERSIONS.RESTORE_KEEPS: Nothing is deleted: restoring creates a new version with the old contents, and the current version stays in the history.
VERSIONS.RESTORE_LOSES: Unsaved changes on your canvas will be lost.
